The 1/(2Pi)^D prefactor is implicit. We keep the full gauge dependence.

amp[0] = FCFAConvert[CreateFeynAmp[diags, Truncated -> True, PreFactor -> 1, GaugeRules -> {}], IncomingMomenta -> {p}, OutgoingMomenta -> {p}, LoopMomenta -> {q}, UndoChiralSplittings -> True, ChangeDimension -> D, SMP -> True, DropSumOver -> True, Contract -> True, FinalSubstitutions -> {SMP["m_u"] -> SMP["m_q"]}]
amp[1] = amp[0] // SUNSimplify[#, FCParallelize -> True] & // TID[#, q, ToPaVe -> True, FCParallelize -> True] & // Total
The self-energy amplitude is usually defined as -i Sigma(p^2)
Notice that the result in the book must be multiplied by (-1) due to the way how self-energy is defined there (c.f. Eq. 2.4.4 and Eq. 2.4.6).
